content.text: Perfect! Let me create one final checksums file for easy verification:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && sha256sum met_inventory_standardized.tsv > CHECKSUMS.txt && echo "# SHA256 Checksums for Verification" >> CHECKSUMS.txt && echo "# Generated for data integrity verification" >> CHECKSUMS.txt && echo "#" >> CHECKSUMS.txt && echo "# To verify file integrity, run:" >> CHECKSUMS.txt && echo "#   sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.txt" >> CHECKSUMS.txt && cat CHECKSUMS.txt
